blends.name: MAKE ITEMS
blends.desc:
# Official Message from the Furthest Asteroid Kgold Empire
In the new agreement under the direction of our dragon rulers, after casting a mold, anyone can craft FAKE JEWELRY, a resource highly desired by our dragon rulers.

Kgold Molds are used to make **FAKE JEWELRY** ( there is a 83% success rate for **Kgold Scraps**)


Click over here to "[Learn more about the Kiperion Mission](https://fake.jewelry)".

blends.name: MINT MOLD
blends.desc:
# Official Message from the Furthest Asteroid Kgold Empire
In the new agreement under the direction of our dragon rulers, after mining Kgold to craft **FAKE JEWELRY** a mold must be cast from the **kgold nuggets**.

**Kgold nuggests** are used to make **Kgold molds** to craft **FAKE JEWELRY **( there is a 50% success rate)

Click over here to "[Learn more about the Kiperion Mission"](https://fake.jewelry).
